items.body:
The v2 migration guide (`MIGRATION.md`, "Router" section) links rou3 to `https://rou3.h3.dev/`. That host has no DNS record, so the link fails. This points it at the rou3 repository, https://github.com/h3js/rou3.

Docs only.
